readout_other: Conditioned place preference, open-field test, elevated plus maze; UPLC-MS/MS of DA, 5-HT, glutamate; HE staining, TEM, cleaved caspase-3 IHC, western blot
direction_notes: Ultrasound alone (H + U) produced no significant change in conditioned place preference, anxiety-like behaviour or NAc neurotransmitter levels; the effects the paper reports are from the microbubble arm, which is not recorded.
safety_notes: HE staining showed no abnormality in the H + U group; no deaths or gait abnormalities. Erythrocyte extravasation, neuropil vacuolation and synapse loss were confined to the microbubble arm.

exposures.label: Focused ultrasound to left NAc (H + U group, ultrasound only)

device.manufacturer: Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences
device.model: portable ultrasound stimulation system with 2 MHz focused transducer

timing.protocol_description: 2 MHz fundamental, 1.34 MPa peak-negative pressure, PRF stated as 1 MHz, 5% duty cycle, 15 min per day over 2 days under 1.5% isoflurane, with 0.2 mL saline given intravenously during stimulation. Only this ultrasound-only arm is recorded; the H + U + MBs arm received SonoVue microbubbles and fails condition D.
